api_surface: anthropic.Anthropic().messages.create (direct Messages API; sync; stream=True for streaming)

claimed_feature_support.note: SDK operations implemented in this probe against Anthropic-native shapes. A framework/SDK operation succeeding OFFLINE says nothing about live Claude behavior or model support; both remain UNVERIFIED until a live run (DevSpec Section 55). The lane exists to preserve Anthropic-native semantics (top-level system, content blocks, tool_use blocks, stop_reason, native stream events), not to prove capability.
claimed_feature_support.roles: sdk_operation_implemented (top-level system + user/assistant messages, not an invented system message)
claimed_feature_support.structured_output: sdk_operation_implemented (native JSON structured output via Messages API output_config.format {type: json_schema, schema}; raw fixture schema preserved; NOT strict tool use, which is a separate tool-input mechanism)
claimed_feature_support.tools: sdk_operation_implemented (tool_use blocks; id/name/input captured natively, not reshaped to an OpenAI function_call)
claimed_feature_support.streaming: sdk_operation_implemented (native message/content_block lifecycle events captured in order)
claimed_feature_support.usage: sdk_operation_implemented (input/output split across message_start/message_delta; cache_creation/cache_read tokens kept distinct)
claimed_feature_support.errors: sdk_operation_implemented (SDK exception type + cause chain + status_code + request_id captured)

native_semantics_notes: The system instruction is a TOP-LEVEL field, not an assistant/system message.
Assistant output is a list of content blocks (text, tool_use), preserved in order — never collapsed.
stop_reason (end_turn / tool_use / refusal / ...) is native and preserved; refusal is a stop_reason, not a parser failure.
Usage is split across stream events and reports cache tokens natively; missing usage stays absent, cache usage stays distinct from ordinary input usage.

Native stream lifecycle: message_start, content_block_start, content_block_delta (text_delta / input_json_delta), content_block_stop, message_delta, message_stop, plus vocabulary-less events like ping.
known_limitations: No live evidence exists yet; all P0.6A verification is offline via a narrow injected fake that returns real Anthropic SDK objects without the network.
Parallel tools, cancellation, timeout, retry, embeddings, and multimodal are out of P0.6A scope.
The probe emits raw evidence and a minimal manifest only; normalization is a harness stage.
No OpenRouter, Bedrock, Vertex, gateway, or custom base_url is configured; only a direct ANTHROPIC_API_KEY satisfies the live credential gate.
